summary.result: The results show that the proposed method can yield a lower cost design than the LMCF alone and that the proposed method can be efficiently used to design irrigation systems or rural water distribution systems.
summary.background: In multiple source pipe network, supply rate at each source node affects the total cost of the system because supply rates are not uniquely determined.
summary.method: A sample pipe network is employed to test the proposed method.
